title: Q-RUNWAY-credentials: unattended runway is 0 days on credentials (target 365)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation runway --probe credentials
**Status:** open

RUNWAY-1: the system is to run 365 days with no person. Component `credentials`: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is invalid. Remove the limit (a route that needs no expiring credential, a cheaper read path, a repair loop for the failure) or make the measurement work; do not change the target.
